achievements.title: Industrial Powerhouse

achievements.title: Architect of Peace

achievements.title: Fiscal Solvency

achievements.title: Beloved Republic

achievements.title: Invulnerable Bastion

achievements.title: Integrity in Office

achievements.title: Visionary Leader
achievements.description: Complete and collect the presidential rewards for at least 3 major national objectives.
